'''September 2001 Colorado tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Collectormania, Colorado on 8 September 2001. It is known from Chris Fanchi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2977">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-18-parker-co-9-15-01d2977/ parker-co-9-15-01], DeckTech (Chris "Artwo" Fanchi, 18 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-18-parker-co-9-15-01d2977/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Collectormania, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
